Our Story

Redefining Laundry in India

FaboNow is India's most trusted laundry and dry cleaning chain. We combine state-of-the-art German technology with a passion for fabric care to deliver the world's best laundry experience at your doorstep.

Our Mission

Liberating You from Laundry Chores

We believe that your time is valuable. Our mission is to liberate you from the mundane chore of laundry, giving you more time for what you love.

By integrating technology with transparency, we introduced the concept of "Live Stores" in India, where customers can see their clothes being processed in a hygienic, professional environment.

100% Transparent
Fast & Reliable

Our Story

Founded with a passion for delivering the highest quality laundry and dry-cleaning services, FABO has grown from a single Hyderabad store into a trusted national brand. Our mission is to create a seamless, convenient experience for every customer — so you can focus on what really matters.

Franchise Success

We are proud of our thriving franchise model, driven by integrated online and offline marketing channels that send steady customer flow to every location. Site selection, interiors, equipment, software, branding, and 30-day staff training are all centrally supported — so franchise partners step into an operation that is already running.

Experience the FABO Difference

From everyday garments to delicate sarees, leather jackets, carpets, and curtains — every item is treated to a fabric-specific process with a per-garment quality check. Whether you book through our website, app, or WhatsApp, your clothes come back fresh, pressed, and tracked end to end.

Why Choose FABO

  • State-of-the-art facilities and Woolmark-approved equipment for exceptional cleaning results
  • Experienced, trained professionals focused on customer satisfaction — not piecework
  • User-friendly website and mobile app for scheduling pickups and tracking deliveries
  • Attentive customer-service team on WhatsApp + call, ready for every question
  • Fully integrated online + offline marketing channels supporting franchise growth
  • Free doorstep pickup and delivery on a minimum bill of ₹1000 — no hidden fees

Our Services

Complete fabric care across every category — same quality standard, whether it's a daily tee or a wedding lehenga.

Laundry Services

State-of-the-art facilities handle a wide range of laundry needs, from everyday garments to delicate fabrics, ensuring perfectly cleaned items every time.

Dry-Cleaning Services

Expert dry-cleaning techniques effectively remove stains and odors while preserving the fabric's integrity and longevity.

Home Furnishing Care

Specialized cleaning for curtains, carpets, sofa covers, and upholstery — keeping your living spaces clean and fresh.

Shoe & Leather Cleaning

Professional cleaning and restoration for all types of footwear — leather dress shoes, premium leather bags, athletic sneakers, and more.

Ironing & Pressing

Meticulous ironing and pressing services to give your garments a crisp, fresh appearance, ready to wear straight out of the wardrobe.

Designer & Saree Care

Surgeon-level handling for silk, bridal lehengas, embroidered sarees, and high-end designer pieces — fabric-by-fabric protocols.
